description: An open dataset for intelligent recognition and classification of abnormal condition in longwall mining is a data set described in a peer-reviewed Scientific Data article written by Wenjuan Yang et al. The underground coal mine production of the fully mechanized mining face exists many problems, such as poor operating environment, high accident rate and so on. Recently, the intelligent autonomous coal mining is gradually replacing the traditional mining process. Coverage: not stated; published in 2023. Formats: Image. The data are held in Figshare and reached through its DOI listed on this page; the paper's Data Records section names it. Access is free of charge and open according to the article. The licence is CC-BY-4.0, taken from DataCite rights of the deposit. Caveats: written from the Scientific Data article metadata (title, abstract, Data Records section) read on 2026-10-01; the data themselves were not opened or downloaded, so their contents, quality and current availability were not checked, and the coverage and resolution are those of the abstract only. It can support industrial-facility and resource studies. Related records: none catalogued yet.
